verdict.rationale: Base44 ships an official CLI that runs from the terminal to create projects, sync data models and code, deploy resources, and run commands against any app, so scripted, headless automation is plausible. The docs never address CI pipelines or non-interactive authentication; the only documented auth step is an interactive `base44 login`. missing for 10: documented CI/CD integration (e.g., GitHub Actions examples), non-interactive or token-based auth for headless runners, explicit headless/non-interactive flags, independent or hands-on corroboration of CI usage.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can run the product headlessly / in CI for automation

citations.quote: The Base44 CLI is a command-line tool for building and managing Base44 apps from your terminal.
Create new backend projects, sync data models and code, deploy resources, and run commands against any app on your account
npm install -g base44@latest # Install the CLI base44 login # Authenticate base44 create # Create a project
